symptom: On a native page, describe → exec turned a heading into body text: Forms$DynamicText.NativeTextStyle Heading3 came back as Text. Describe printed `dynamictext text4 (Content: 'JTS boat log')`; `NativeTextStyle: Heading3` written by hand passed parsing with an MDL-WIDGET07 'will be silently dropped' warning
cause: MDL had no spelling for NativeTextStyle: no model field, the builder read nothing, describe read nothing, and both writers (modelsdk widget_write.go and the MCP backend's page_widgets.go) hard-coded "Text"
file: sdk/pages/pages_widgets_display.go (NativeTextStyle, CanonicalNativeTextStyle); mdl/executor/cmd_pages_builder_v3_widgets.go (buildDynamicTextV3); mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_parse.go, cmd_pages_describe_output.go; mdl/backend/modelsdk/widget_write.go; mdl/backend/mcp/page_widgets.go; mdl/backend/pagemutator/mutator.go (setDynamicTextNativeTextStyleMut); mdl/executor/validate_widgets.go
fix: Add `NativeTextStyle: Text | Heading1..Heading6` to dynamictext (case-insensitive, canonical on write, unknown refused with the list), print it when not Text, write it in both backends, accept it in `alter page … set`, and add it to the built-in widget vocabulary
insight: A hard-coded literal in a writer is the cheapest tell for this class: `grep -n 'Set\w*("' widget_write.go` lists every property the writer can never vary, and the generated enum (modelsdk/gen/pages/enums.go) says whether the literal is the only member. Copy fixes to every writer: the MCP backend had the same literal. A fixture survey shows why no round-trip test caught it: PedApp stores Text on all 284 dynamic texts, so a Studio Pro fixture without native headings cannot fail; the repro needs a BSON edit
